type_text:
∀ {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (labels : List (Fin m)) (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
      (rows : ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow) (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ)
      (τ : Fin n → ENNReal),
      Monotone τ →
        ∀ (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
          outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ answer →
            ∀ (j : Fin n),
              ↑((outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n labels x start rows answer (n * labels.length)).clock -
                    start) ≤
                ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.couponWork n labels x start rows answer j + (↑j + 1)) /
                    ∑ i ≤ j, (τ i)⁻¹ +
                  τ j
